dict.string: Reflect uses the microphone to record audio memos and the meetings you choose to record, transcribed into your notes.
Reflect records what your Mac plays alongside the microphone while you record, so a call's other side is transcribed on this Mac.
Reflect reads your calendar to show the day's meetings beside your daily note. Access is read-only and stays on this device.
